verbatim_quote.original: All feature verification must run through Docker (`docker run --rm -i`); Firefox/Browsh/html2markdown are not installed on the host.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: All feature verification must run through Docker (`docker run --rm -i`); Firefox/Browsh/html2markdown are not installed on the host.

extracted_decision.summary: Verify features only through Docker; never run the server on the host.
extracted_decision.rationale: The host lacks Firefox/Browsh/html2markdown, so host runs are meaningless.
alternatives: Install the binaries on the host
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Slower verification loop, but trustworthy and reproducible.
